entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the Mountain Bike Shoes delivered on October 28th, which was 42 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's more of a fit and comfort issue. I've used them a few times, but they're causing painful blisters on my heels, regardless of how I adjust them or the cleats.
I'm sorry to hear that. The right fit is everything when you're on the bike. Let me just confirm our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, I've checked the details. Since your purchase was delivered within the last 90 days, it is absolutely eligible for a return. We can process a full refund for you once we receive the item.

Okay, a refund sounds good. I appreciate that. Now, since I did have this trouble and will have to find another pair, would it be possible to get a discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model from you guys.

That's a very fair question. I see on your account that you are a VIP member, and we absolutely want to make this right. I can definitely add a 15% discount code to your account for your next order. I'm also sending you a pre-paid return shipping label right now.
A 15% discount and a pre-paid label? That's perfect, thank you, Alex. That's a great help and makes the process much easier.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could provide a solution that works for you. The email with the label and confirmation of the discount code should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
